selection_rule: Before inspecting outcomes: smallest active numeric Defects4J bug ID in each of Time, Lang, Math, excluding Time-25. No replacement based on gold recall or model outcomes. Input incompatibility is reported, not silently replaced.
held_out_reservation: IDs 2..5 in these projects are not evaluated by this manifest; future train/calibration/test splits must use disjoint bugs and avoid all development cases
pre_inference_budget_note: Raised from initial 16k plan to 20k after source-only preflight (25 candidates and estimated L1 totals 24,254 / 19,606); no model response or gold outcome had been inspected. Full has a separate completion-reference budget.
global_admission: Reserve num_ctx + num_predict for each uncached request, a conservative bound on provider prompt plus output counters. Abort on any bound violation or unknown usage. Never lower the reservation by consulting cached future costs.
failure_evidence: Existing FlexFL trigger-test text; Java tests are not rerun locally. Identical text across paired arms. No post-hoc Time-25 variants.
